claims.text: Animate the supplied photograph with slow drifting motion over five seconds.

The image is a photorealistic character reference sheet with a rainy night hero panel at top, a three-view turnaround row in the middle, and a four-panel detail row at the bottom, labelled HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS.

The recurring figure has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot, a black high-collared tactical jacket, black cargo trousers and black lace-up combat boots, and stands with arms relaxed while the head is turned up and to the left in the hero panel.
A soft steady rain ambience with a faint distant city hum accompanies the drifting motion, matching the wet night setting of the hero panel.

description.text: The complete supplied reference sheet fills the frame exactly as given, uncropped and unaltered: across the top a wide hero panel shows an adult figure in a black high-collared tactical jacket with zip and strap-and-buckle hardware, dark undershirt, black cargo trousers with pockets and straps, and black lace-up combat boots, standing with arms relaxed at the sides on wet reflective pavement between metal railings, head turned up and to the left, rain streaking through cool ambient night air while blurred city lights and warm amber practical lamps glow behind. Below it the middle row holds full-body front, side-profile and back turnaround views of the same lean figure with short dark hair, shaved sides and a small topknot, lit softly against near-black charcoal studio backing. Along the bottom sit four detail crops: the face with its neutral serious expression and a scar crossing one eyebrow, the buckled jacket collar, two weathered bare hands with visible veins and grime, and worn black lace-up boots. Centered uppercase labels reading HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS stay in position beneath their panels. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, a gentle constant drift that keeps every panel, pose and printed word intact while the falling rain inside the hero panel slides downward and the wet pavement and amber lamps shimmer faintly, giving the still sheet a quiet pulse of life.
Soft steady rain ambience with a faint distant city hum, low and even, with no voices.
The entire reference sheet is present at once, hero panel, three turnaround views and four detail crops with all eight printed labels legible, in desaturated high-contrast photorealistic rendering.
The slow push in edges closer across the sheet while rain streaks in the hero panel drift downward and the amber practical lights and wet pavement glimmer gently.

The lean adult figure in black tactical clothing holds the same relaxed stance with head turned up and to the left, rain sliding past, as the drift continues without any change to the layout or lettering.
